title: Hospital bed-management modernization (single-speaker monologue)
notes: Single-speaker lecture (all customer turns). Evidence turn_index is 0-based into transcript.turns; quotes are verbatim substrings.

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Halve ER boarding time; board target is under two hours.

evidence.quote: the target the board has set is under two

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The bed coordinator needs a real-time, rule-aware view of bed availability.

evidence.quote: a real-time, rule-aware view of bed availability

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Environmental services needs a notification the moment a room is vacated.

evidence.quote: environmental services needs a notification the moment a room is vacated

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Automatically notify housekeeping when a bed is ready for cleaning (today it is a manual call/page).
Encode bed-assignment exception rules (isolation, pediatric, post-surgical) in the system.

evidence.quote: those rules live in the coordinator's head, not in any system

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Integrate with Epic via HL7 as a consumer of bed-status and ADT events.

evidence.quote: integrate with our existing Epic EHR instance

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Enforce HIPAA-scoped, role-based visibility in the system (not by policy alone).

evidence.quote: that access boundary has to be enforced by the system, not just by policy

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Do not replace Epic; Epic remains the system of record.
Handle device/connectivity limits: Android handhelds without data plan; Wi-Fi does not reach the sub-basement.

evidence.quote: does not reach the sub-basement mechanical areas

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Deliver within ~five months; live before the fiscal year closes at end of June.

evidence.quote: live before the fiscal year closes at the end of June

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: User adoption / clinical-staff trust is itself a requirement.

evidence.quote: user adoption is as much a requirement as any technical spec

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: ER boarding time reduced from ~5 hours toward under 2.
Bed turnover time reduced from 90 minutes to under 40.

evidence.quote: come down from an average of ninety minutes to under forty

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Ambulance diversion hours drop by at least half within two quarters of go-live.

evidence.quote: drop by at least half within two quarters of go-live

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Does EVS need a mobile app or is an SMS/paging trigger enough?

evidence.quote: whether environmental services needs a mobile app or whether a simple SMS or paging trigger is enough

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: How to model a clean bed held (reserved) for a specific incoming transfer vs available?

evidence.quote: a bed that's clean and ready but held for a specific incoming transfer
